notes.title: Are you ready to venture to a paradise island? "Island, Sex & Survival" is officially released!!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36388466/8fd64c07b89d6d247cca94a773ceb6d27715abbb.png[/img]

"Island X Love X Survival" is now officially released!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2911250/_X__X/
[h3][b][Game Introduction][/b][/h3]

The gameplay combines visual novel elements with light survival and crafting systems. There are six unique female characters who will survive on the island with you. Players need to explore the uninhabited island to collect resources, cook various dishes, and craft tools to aid their survival. You can also invite the female characters to join you in adventures, trade resources with them, and build affection to trigger various wild events!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36388466/e31f990e727466ce88ed124acb2c0a67c61bd57f.png[/img]

[h3][b][Game Features][/b][/h3]
[list]
    [*]Visual novel gameplay with light gathering and crafting systems
    [*]Six unique female characters
    [*]Multiple ending routes
    [*]Over 34 CGs, including 19 animated CGs
[/list]
